layer_3_action.subject: Bright, sunny view of lush prehistoric coastal lowlands
features: dense, vibrant green water-tolerant vegetation, including large ferns and early mangrove-like trees
sparkling lagoons with clear, warm water
bright sunlight illuminating ethereal mist rising from water in patches
clearly visible banks of dark, rich organic mud covered in liverworts and moss
clusters of horsetails (Equisetum) along the water's edge
layer_3_action.action: Depict a cheerfully bright and warm coastal lowland environment at mid-day, focusing on the vivid plant life (ferns, mosses, horsetails, no grass), sunlit water features, and clear skies, with any mist appearing magical.

visuals.ground: Expansive areas of clearly visible dark, rich organic mud, highlighted by sunlight along the banks of lagoons and estuaries, supporting dense, vibrant green ferns, liverworts, and mosses. No grass.
visuals.water: Numerous sparkling lagoons and slow, winding estuaries with clear, warm water, brightly reflecting the blue sky, with gentle, wispy mist rising in sunlit patches.
visuals.sky: Bright, clear blue sky with fluffy white clouds, strong, direct mid-day sun creating a warm and inviting atmosphere.

strata_specifics.ground_texture: Wet, deeply organic mud, clearly visible with texture, supporting lush, vibrant ferns, mosses, and horsetails. No grass.

mood: Lush, bright, inviting, vibrant, scientifically accurate (no grass)
